verdict.rationale: Proactive compliance alerts are a fair axis for an EOR and global-hiring platform like Oyster, but the evidence pack never documents alerts tied to new hires, new locations, or law changes creating obligations. The webhooks are a generic developer event-push building block, illustrated with an expense approval event. The country-specific rulesets are field validations, not notifications. Neither counts as the alerting capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation
